rows.requirement: Treat open HMLR INSPIRE and ordinary title-plan geometry as general-boundary evidence unless determined evidence is present.
Do not assign a numeric legal-boundary tolerance, measurement or ratio to a general boundary.
When title-specific evidence is used, reconcile the title plan with the register and filed documents.
Require title-specific boundary agreement or determined-boundary evidence before exact-boundary promotion.
Use OSTN15 or the accepted EPSG operation and reject simple Helmert conversion.
Require source frame and observation epoch before WGS84-to-ETRS89 interpretation.
Require OSGM15 and ODN lineage for mainland orthometric heights.
Keep OSGM15 model accuracy separate from LIDAR, boundary and sampling uncertainty.
Use time-stamped DTM as ground terrain; never substitute DSM ground extrema.
Require the official ±15 cm RMSE product claim and survey metadata.
Record available ground-truth survey date, ±3 cm RMSE lineage and applicability window.
Classify surveys against less-than ±15 cm RMSE and 10 cm standard-deviation/random-error controls when evidence exists.
Fetch object IDs separately before requesting feature records.
Request deterministic object-ID subsets within the live record limit and reconcile exact requested versus returned IDs.
Preserve and hash service metadata, ID arrays and every feature batch response.
Publish engineering evidence separately from legal-boundary status; keep final_ready false until all real gates pass.
